text:
maria: Quick heads-up: planning a VPC/on-prem installer cutover tonight. Preflight checklist below — need heartbeat from packaging, signer, and deploy pipeline by 21:00 PST or we hold. @jamal @kevin @deploy-bot :wave:
jamal: Packaging status: built rc3, size 1.2GB, incremental delta applied. Pushing to mirror now, ETA ~4m. Will abort push on checksum mismatch.
build-bot: build-bot: artifact uploaded to s3://private-release/vpc/rc3/installer.tar.gz (manifest: rc3-manifest.json)
kevin: Signer: cosign sig posted to https://signer.internal/reports/rc3, cosign:sha256:deadbeef. KMS key: projects/redwood/kms/key1.
depploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting preflight checks: checksum, manifest validation, network probes, kubeconn. All checks queued. Canary window recommended at 21:10 PST. Run `/deploy start canary --manifest rc3-manifest.json` to initiate.
tara: Ops note: KMS rotation scheduled 21:30 PST in eu-west region. If we cross that window signatures may be revalidated. Prefer full cutover before or after rotation.
alex: Proposal: canary -> 10 hosts (VPC corridor), 30m observation, then ramp. If any package or signer failure revert pin to rc2 and halt.
jamal: Acknowledged. If deploy-bot reports bad checksum I'll lock the tag and notify. Quick sanity check command on artifacts: ```tar -tvf installer.tar.gz | head -n 5```
depploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight OK except kv-cache warmup not present. Suggest env REDWOOD_CACHE_WARM=true for canary to reduce latency spikes.
sre-bot: sre-bot: monitoring hooks added: p95 latency, error rate, token-cost anomaly. Alert rule: p95 > 350ms OR error_rate > 1% triggers paging.
maria: I'm updating release notes with delta summary and pin manifest epoch: rc3-2026-03-21. Adding rollback instructions (pin->rc2, run `./installer rollback --manifest rc2-manifest.json`).
kevin: Cosign TTL check: signature expiry OK for 30 days. If we need emergency resigning, I can re-sign after rotation but that will delay cutover ~15m.
jamal: pushing mirror verified, md5/sha256 match. If deploybot asks for hold I will `mirror:hold` and open a quick-release incident.
depploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled at 1759992000. Will execute canary start at that epoch unless a manual hold is issued. To abort: `/deploy cancel canary rc3`
maria: LGTM. If no objections by 20:55 PST we proceed. I'll be on standby in case we need to roll forward/back. :thumbsup:
jamal: :+1:
kevin: :shipit:
